description: Return a fresh timestamped list of live x402 endpoints scraped from public catalogs (PayAI, CDP), optionally 402-probed. Pick this when the question is 'what x402 APIs exist right now?'. Returns a free sample plus the paid URL and pay steps (no charge here); the full result costs $0.025 Base USDC via x402.
